/-- Ordinary divisor count, retaining exactly the weight in the finite fold. -/
def tau (n : ℕ) : ℝ := (n.divisors.card : ℝ)

/-- Keep the large shifted order symbolic throughout the Cauchy calculation. -/
def kshift : ℕ := 512 ^ 2

def mixedCarrier (x : ℝ) (a : ℤ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Ioc 0 ⌊6 * x⌋₊).filter (fun v => (v : ℤ) ≠ a)

def mixedSum (x : ℝ) (a : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a,
    tau v * tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
      (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4

theorem kshift_eq : kshift = 262144 := by
  norm_num only [kshift]

theorem kshift_ge_two : 2 ≤ kshift := by
  rw [kshift_eq]
  exact Nat.le_of_lt (by decide : 2 < 262144)

/-- Both zero endpoints are excluded by the unchanged original carrier. -/
theorem mixedCarrier_nonzero {x : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {v : ℕ}
    (hv : v ∈ mixedCarrier x a) :
    v ≠ 0 ∧ ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hvI, hva⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hv
  exact ⟨(Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hvI).1.ne',
    Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hva)⟩

/-- Native d2*d4^4 is paid by d512 without a squarefree hypothesis. -/
theorem shifted_weight_le (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    tau t * (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ (fouvryTau 512 t : ℝ) := by
  have hp : (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ (fouvryTau (4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fouvryTau_pow_le 4 4 ht
  have hm : (fouvryTau 2 t : ℝ) * (fouvryTau (4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) ≤
      (fouvryTau (2 * 4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fouvryTau_mul_le 2 (4 ^ 4) t
  have hord : 2 * (4 : ℕ) ^ 4 = 512 := by norm_num
  calc
    tau t * (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤
        tau t * (fouvryTau (4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = (fouvryTau 2 t : ℝ) * (fouvryTau (4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) := by
      rw [tau, fouvryTau_two]
    _ ≤ (fouvryTau (2 * 4 ^ 4) t : ℝ) := hm
    _ = (fouvryTau 512 t : ℝ) := by rw [hord]

theorem tau_sq_le_four (v : ℕ) : tau v ^ 2 ≤ (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ) := by
  have h : fouvryTau 2 v ^ 2 ≤ fouvryTau 4 v := by
    simpa only [show (2 : ℕ) ^ 2 = 4 from rfl] using fouvryTau_sq_le 2 v
  rw [tau, ← fouvryTau_two v]
  exact_mod_cast h

theorem shifted_weight_sq_le (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (tau t * (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 2 ≤
      (fouvryTau kshift t : ℝ) := by
  have h0 : 0 ≤ tau t * (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4 :=
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have hsq : (tau t * (fouvryTau 4 t : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 2 ≤
      (fouvryTau 512 t : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ h0 (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).2 (shifted_weight_le t ht)
  have hn : (fouvryTau 512 t : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (fouvryTau (512 ^ 2) t : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast fouvryTau_sq_le 512 t
  exact hsq.trans hn

/-- Genuine finite Cauchy on the supplied ordered carrier. No bound is a premise. -/
theorem mixed_sum_sq_le (S : Finset ℕ) (a : ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, (v : ℤ) ≠ a) :
    (∑ v ∈ S, tau v * tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
      (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ v ∈ S, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ)) *
        ∑ v ∈ S, (fouvryTau kshift ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) := by
  have hleft : (∑ v ∈ S, tau v ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ S, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun v _ => tau_sq_le_four v)
  have hright :
      (∑ v ∈ S, (tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
        (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ S, (fouvryTau kshift ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro v hv
    exact shifted_weight_sq_le _
      (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hS v hv)))
  calc
    _ = (∑ v ∈ S, tau v * (tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
          (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4)) ^ 2 := by
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ (∑ v ∈ S, tau v ^ 2) *
        ∑ v ∈ S, (tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
          (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq S (fun v => tau v)
        (fun v => tau ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs *
          (fouvryTau 4 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) ^ 4)
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hleft hright
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _))

/-- The original positive filtered Ioc version of the exact finite inequality. -/
theorem mixedSum_sq_le (x : ℝ) (a : ℤ) :
    mixedSum x a ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ)) *
        ∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a,
          (fouvryTau kshift ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) := by
  exact mixed_sum_sq_le (mixedCarrier x a) a
    (fun _ hv => (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2)

/-- The same finite Cauchy conclusion with the shifted order displayed literally. -/
theorem mixedSum_sq_le_262144_sums (x : ℝ) (a : ℤ) :
    mixedSum x a ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ)) *
        ∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a,
          (fouvryTau 262144 ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ) := by
  simpa only [kshift_eq] using mixedSum_sq_le x a

/-- Consume the native global prefix theorem on the unchanged filtered carrier. -/
theorem unshifted_sum_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (a : ℤ) :
    (∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ)) ≤
      6 * x * (1 + Real.log (6 * x)) ^ 3 := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊6 * x⌋₊, (fouvryTau 4 v : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
        (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (fun _ _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [show (4 : ℕ) - 1 = 3 from rfl] using
        sum_fouvryTau_le_real (k := 4) (by decide) (by linarith : 1 ≤ 6 * x)

/-- Exact finite payment for every nonnegative kappa; no power absorption. -/
theorem mixedSum_sq_le_exact {x κ : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : |(a : ℝ)| ≤ x ^ (1 + κ)) :
    mixedSum x a ^ 2 ≤
      (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (6 * x)) ^ 3) *
        (2 * (kshift : ℝ) *
          (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (kshift - 1) +
            (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (kshift : ℝ)) *
              (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (kshift - 2))) := by
  have hs :
      (∑ v ∈ mixedCarrier x a,
        (fouvryTau kshift ((v : ℤ) - a).natAbs : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * (kshift : ℝ) *
        (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (kshift - 1) +
          (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (kshift : ℝ)) *
            (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ (kshift - 2)) :=
    ImbalancedChen.Part3.ElementaryShiftedTau.shifted_tau_Ioc_sum_le
      kshift_ge_two hx hκ a ha
  have hbase : 0 ≤ 6 * x * (1 + Real.log (6 * x)) ^ 3 := by
    have h6x : 0 ≤ 6 * x := by linarith
    have hlog : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (6 * x) := by
      have := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith : 1 ≤ 6 * x)
      linarith
    exact mul_nonneg h6x (pow_nonneg hlog _)
  exact (mixedSum_sq_le x a).trans (mul_le_mul (unshifted_sum_le hx a) hs
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _)) hbase)

/-- The requested literal order/exponent version; no large power is expanded. -/
theorem mixedSum_sq_le_262144 {x κ : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : |(a : ℝ)| ≤ x ^ (1 + κ)) :
    mixedSum x a ^ 2 ≤
      (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (6 * x)) ^ 3) *
        (2 * (262144 : ℝ) *
          (6 * x * (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ 262143 +
            (7 * x ^ (1 + κ)) ^ (1 - 1 / (262144 : ℝ)) *
              (1 + Real.log (7 * x ^ (1 + κ))) ^ 262142)) := by
  simpa only [kshift_eq,
    show (262144 : ℕ) - 1 = 262143 from rfl,
    show (262144 : ℕ) - 2 = 262142 from rfl] using
      mixedSum_sq_le_exact hx hκ a ha

end

theorem fouvryTau_two (n : ℕ) : fouvryTau 2 n = n.divisors.card := by
  rw [show 2 = 1 + 1 from rfl, fouvryTau_succ]
  trans ∑ _d ∈ n.divisors, 1
  · exact sum_congr rfl (fun d hd => fouvryTau_order_one (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd).ne')
  · simp

theorem fouvryTau_mul_le (k l n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau k n * fouvryTau l n ≤ fouvryTau (k * l) n := by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  rw [(fouvryTau_multiplicative k).multiplicative_factorization _ hn,
    (fouvryTau_multiplicative l).multiplicative_factorization _ hn,
    (fouvryTau_multiplicative (k * l)).multiplicative_factorization _ hn]
  simp only [Finsupp.prod, Nat.support_factorization]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  apply Finset.prod_le_prod'
  intro p hp
  simp only [fouvryTau_prime_pow (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)]
  exact multichoose_mul_le _ _ _

theorem fouvryTau_pow_le (k r : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    fouvryTau k n ^ r ≤ fouvryTau (k ^ r) n := by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [fouvryTau_order_one hn]
  | succ r ih =>
    calc
      _ = fouvryTau k n ^ r * fouvryTau k n := pow_succ _ _
      _ ≤ fouvryTau (k ^ r) n * fouvryTau k n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ih
      _ ≤ fouvryTau (k ^ r * k) n := fouvryTau_mul_le _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ]

theorem sum_fouvryTau_le_real {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ)) ≤
      x * (1 + Real.log x) ^ (k - 1) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  have hfloor : 1 ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ := Nat.le_floor (by simpa using hx)
  have hlog : 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log x := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < ⌊x⌋₊ by omega))
      (Nat.floor_le (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))
    linarith
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ by exact_mod_cast hfloor)
    linarith
  simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_one] using
    (sum_fouvryTau_le j ⌊x⌋₊).trans
      (mul_le_mul (Nat.floor_le (by linarith)) (pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg hlog j)
        (pow_nonneg hnonneg j) (by linarith : 0 ≤ x))

lemma sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq [CommSemiring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]
    [ExistsAddOfLE R] (s : Finset ι)
    (f g : ι → R) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i * g i) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i ^ 2) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i ^ 2 :=
  sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul s
    (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) (fun _ _ ↦ sq_nonneg _) (fun _ _ ↦ (mul_pow ..).le)

/-- **Sedrakyan's lemma**, aka **Titu's lemma** or **Engel's form**.

@[to_additive (attr := gcongr) sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' [MulLeftMono N] (h : s ⊆ t)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → 1 ≤ f i) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by
  classical calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ (∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left' <| one_le_prod' <| by simpa only [mem_sdiff, and_imp]
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, f i := (prod_union sdiff_disjoint).symm
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]

@[to_additive]
